about: Hand-written map from paragraphs of replaced RBI instruments to the paragraph of the NBFC Credit Facilities Directions, 2025 (RBI/DOR/2025-26/347, Chapter III) that now carries the rule. Each row was checked by reading both paragraphs on rbi.org.in on 2026-10-16. relation: 'carried_over' = same rule, only the entity name changes (RE to NBFC) or cross-references are updated; 'amended' = the rule itself changed, as stated in the note. Repeal chain: 2022 and 2023 circulars repealed by RBI/2025-26/36 (para 30(i), Annex III); RBI/2025-26/36 withdrawn on 28 Nov 2025 by RBI/2025-26/100 and replaced for NBFCs by RBI/DOR/2025-26/347 (para 112).

rows.note: Sub-paras i-vii become (1)-(7) with 'RE' replaced by 'NBFC'; (6) now names the NBFC Managing Risks in Outsourcing Directions, 2025.
Same four requirements on the LSP's digital view of loan offers; 'multiple REs' becomes 'multiple lenders'.
Old text points to the KFS circular DOR.STR.REC.13/13.03.00/2024-25 of 15 Apr 2024; new text points to the NBFC Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.

rows.topic: Repayment directly into the lender's bank account
rows.note: No pass-through or pool account of any third party, including the LSP; wording identical apart from RE to NBFC.

rows.topic: LSP fees paid by the lender, not the borrower
rows.note: Wording identical apart from RE to NBFC.

Minimum stays one day. Old: period 'determined by the Board of the RE as laid down in their loan policy'; new: 'determined by the NBFC in terms of their credit policy'. Pre-payment now refers to the NBFC Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.

rows.topic: Need-based data collection; no access to phone resources
rows.note: Same consent, audit-trail and one-time-access rules; RE replaced by NBFC.

rows.topic: Data stored only in India; 24-hour return
rows.note: Wording identical apart from RE to NBFC.

rows.topic: Reporting DLAs on the CIMS portal
rows.note: Same reporting duty; 'CIMS portal of RBI' becomes 'CIMS portal of the Reserve Bank'.

rows.topic: DLG cap of five per cent of amount disbursed
rows.note: Wording identical apart from RE to NBFC.
Wording identical apart from RE to NBFC.

Repealed by RBI/2025-26/36 (Annex III), whose para 9 then became para 10 of the NBFC Directions. The 2022 paragraph corresponds to sub-paras (1) and (2); (4) on LSP fees came from 2022 para 4.1; the bar on third-party control of fund flows (3), cash recovery in delinquent loans (5) and the salary-advance proviso are not in the 2022 paragraph.
2022: not less than three days for loans of tenor seven days or more, one day for shorter loans. Now: not less than one day for all loans, set by the NBFC in its credit policy.
Five per cent is unchanged, but the base changes from 'the amount of that loan portfolio' to 'the total amount disbursed out of that loan portfolio at any given time'.
120-day limit unchanged; 'unless made good by the borrower' becomes 'unless the loan dues are made good by the borrower'.
